title: Grade 7 Lessons 1 3
description: Grade 7 multiple-choice question bank. Each question has four options and one correct answer.

questions.question: Which situation is the best example of an active digital footprint?

options.text: Posting a photo or comment online yourself
A website recording your visit automatically
A browser saving cookies without asking you to type anything
An internet provider recording connection details

questions.question: Which statement best explains a passive digital footprint?

options.text: Information you deliberately post online
Information collected about your online activity without you actively providing it
A profile you create using a nickname
A message you send to a friend

questions.question: Why do advertisers track a user's digital footprint?

options.text: To delete the user's online accounts
To stop the user from visiting websites
To understand interests and show targeted advertisements
To make the internet connection faster

questions.question: Maya uploads a photo of her project to a social media site for her friends to see. She manually types a caption and clicks Publish. Which type of digital footprint did Maya create?

options.text: A passive digital footprint
A temporary digital footprint
An offline footprint
An active digital footprint

questions.question: Liam searches several gaming websites for a particular game. Later, he notices advertisements for similar games while visiting another website. Which explanation is most likely?

options.text: Tracking technologies recorded his browsing activity and helped select related advertisements
His computer automatically bought the games
The websites shared his password publicly
The advertisements appeared by complete coincidence in every case

questions.question: What does the term “cyber-vet” mean?

options.text: A person who repairs animals using computers
A person who checks and evaluates online information or activity carefully
A program that removes all internet advertisements
A person who creates social media accounts for others

questions.question: Is the claim that turning off a camera removes your digital footprint correct?

options.text: Yes, because a camera creates every online record
Yes, because websites stop collecting information when the camera is off
No, because online activity can still be recorded through posts, searches, cookies, and other activity
No, because a digital footprint only comes from photographs

questions.question: Before posting a personal story online, you realise that strangers may be able to read it. What is the most responsible response?

options.text: Post it immediately because online posts are always private
Include your address so readers know who you are
Ask strangers to decide whether it is safe
Review the content and privacy settings, and avoid sharing sensitive personal details

questions.question: What is an online profile?

options.text: A personal page or account containing information about a user on a website or online service
A program used only to repair computers
A list of websites stored in a browser
A document that can only be printed

questions.question: What is the main purpose of an avatar in an online profile?

options.text: To reveal a user's home address
To represent the user with a picture or character, often without showing their real photo
To store the user's passwords
To prevent all online messages

questions.question: David notices that strangers are sending him friend requests on his social profile. He wants to change his settings so only people he knows can connect with him. Which action should David take first?

options.text: Accept every request
Post his phone number publicly
Change his account's privacy or friend-request settings
Create another public profile

questions.question: Why might companies use a person's browsing and search history?

options.text: To automatically repair the person's computer
To find the person's school timetable
To stop the person from using search engines
To understand interests and personalize advertisements or services

questions.question: What is the main purpose of privacy settings on an online account?

options.text: To control who can see information and interact with the account
To make every post visible to everyone
To increase the number of advertisements
To remove the need for a password

questions.question: Alex is setting up a new account on a popular gaming network. He wants to pick a handle that keeps his real identity hidden from strangers online. Which username choice is safest for Alex?

options.text: AlexMainali2012
DragonPlayer47
Alex_Bhaktapur_House12
AlexMainaliSchool6A

questions.question: Why do private profiles provide better security than public ones?

options.text: They make users impossible to find under any circumstances
They prevent all types of cybercrime
They limit who can view profile information and posts
They automatically delete every message

questions.question: A student uses a Check-In feature and announces where they will be later that evening. Why could this be risky?

options.text: It makes the phone battery charge more slowly
It prevents friends from contacting the student
It hides the student's location from everyone
It may reveal the student's location and plans to people they do not know

questions.question: What is online shopping?

options.text: Buying goods or services through websites or apps on the internet
Exchanging books only in a classroom
Repairing a computer using the internet
Selling products without communicating with buyers

questions.question: What does the term “online auction” describe?

options.text: A website where products are always free
An online process where people place bids to compete to buy an item
A service for sending private messages
A website used only for banking

questions.question: Where can you perform activities with online banking?

options.text: Only at a shopping centre
Only by sending a letter to the bank
Through a bank's website or mobile application using an internet-connected device
Only at a school computer laboratory

questions.question: What is the main purpose of online information security?

options.text: To make all online information public
To increase the number of advertisements
To make passwords easy for everyone to guess
To protect information and systems from unauthorized access, misuse, or damage

questions.question: What is a “payment gateway” in online transactions?

options.text: A tool that connects an online store with a payment service to process payments securely
A website that displays product photographs
A program that creates social media profiles
A device used only to print receipts

questions.question: Zara wants to buy a book from an online store she has never used. She sees a “Buy It Now” option. What should she consider before buying?

options.text: Buy immediately because the button guarantees safety
Check the seller and website reputation, product details, price, and payment security
Share her password with the seller
Ignore delivery costs and return conditions

questions.question: Alex is using a public computer in the library to check his bank account. He needs to transfer money to a friend. What should he avoid doing?

options.text: Checking that the website address is correct
Logging out after using the account
Saving his banking password in the browser or leaving the account signed in
Making sure nobody can see his screen

questions.question: Maria found an amazing deal on a new phone at an online auction site. The seller has very few reviews and a low rating. What is the safest action for Maria?

options.text: Pay immediately before the offer ends
Send money directly outside the auction platform
Ignore the seller's rating
Avoid the purchase until she can verify the seller and the offer is trustworthy

questions.question: In a typical online auction, what usually happens as more buyers compete for an item?

options.text: The bids may increase as buyers offer higher prices
The item automatically becomes free
The seller loses the item immediately
All buyers receive the item

questions.question: A user wants to create a new account for online banking. They are asked to create a password. Which action follows the security guidelines?

options.text: Use their name and date of birth
Create a long, unique password that is difficult to guess
Use the same password as every other account
Share the password with a friend for safekeeping

questions.question: What is a sensible way to reduce the risk of online auction fraud?

options.text: Always choose the cheapest offer
Pay using an untraceable method requested by the seller
Use the platform's protected payment system and check seller reviews
Ignore the item's description and seller details
